metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.4 · 1984 · Beverly Hills Cop
metas.description: A freewheeling Detroit cop pursuing a murder investigation finds himself dealing with the very different culture of Beverly Hills.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.6 · 1987 · Beverly Hills Cop II
metas.description: Axel Foley returns to Beverly Hills to help Taggart and Rosewood investigate Chief Bogomil's near-fatal shooting and the series of "alphabet crimes" associated with it.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 5.5 · 1994 · Beverly Hills Cop III
metas.description: While investigating a car theft ring, Axel Foley comes across a much bigger crime; the same men who killed his boss are running a counterfeit money ring out of a theme park in Los Angeles.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 6.4 · 2024 · Beverly Hills Cop: Axel F
metas.description: Axel Foley returns to Beverly Hills after his daughter's life is threatened for a family reunion that includes old pals John Taggart and Billy Rosewood to uncover a conspiracy.
